temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary has been working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. In their conversation, Gary declines Ethan's invitation to a weekend retreat because he has too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dedicated and hardworking, but he is worried Gary may be pushing himself too hard and neglecting his health.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Gary's refusal confirms that his overwork is serious and that he feels unable to step away, even for a short break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is severely overworked and currently unwilling or unable to take time off because of hospital responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To keep supporting Gary and look for ways to help him rest or reduce his stress, even though the retreat invitation was declined.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. When confronted, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is mainly tied to hospital obligations, though he remains concerned and thinks Gary may need rest.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Gary's restlessness and avoidance make Ethan suspect there is more going on than professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is hiding or struggling with deeper, complicated issues that go beyond work, and that Gary may be reluctant to share them.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary, encourage him to open up, and offer nonjudgmental support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges. Gary agrees that he could use help organizing his schedule and making time for himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary is facing deeper problems beyond ordinary hospital workload, but he does not yet know the specifics.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Ethan now understands the specific professional and personal pressures behind Gary's overwork, and learns Gary is willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is driven by both new-department pressures and personal challenges, and that Gary can improve with support and better planning.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule to find a healthier balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in regularly. He sees Gary making efforts to change and hears Gary say he is less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is trying to improve and still faces challenges, but Ethan remains hopeful and attentive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Gary's reports and visible efforts strengthen Ethan's belief that the changes are working and that his support is helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is making meaningful progress toward a healthier work-life balance and is less overwhelmed than before.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering support, and encouraging Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Ethan sees that Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and is capable of managing on his own. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has improved significantly, but he may still think Gary could benefit from occasional support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Ethan recognizes that Gary has achieved a sustainable balance and can manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary no longer needs active intervention and is fully capable of maintaining his healthier work-life balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support while remaining available if Gary ever needs him.
